name: embedding_lora_a
description: embedding_lora_a(input_ids, weights, batch_info, vocab_size, extra_embeddings=None) -> out. input_ids is a one-dimensional token-id tensor; weights has shape [num_lora, r, vocab_size]; batch_info supplies bs, seg_indptr, weight_indices, lora_ranks, and max_len; vocab_size is the base vocabulary size. For each segment b, let w_idx = weight_indices[b] and active_r = lora_ranks[w_idx]. For token positions in the segment, out[start:end, :active_r] is weights[w_idx, :active_r, token].T, or extra_embeddings[w_idx, token-vocab_size, :active_r] when the token exceeds vocab_size and extra_embeddings is provided. Positions beyond the active rank are zero. Returns a new [S, r] tensor with weights.dtype. Empty token sets return an empty output. No input mutation; the exercised dtype is bfloat16.
